findings.summary: The work queue initializes all batches with the same pre-poll runningStartSha as batchStartSha, causing rollbackFix on later failed batches to incorrectly revert successful commits from earlier batches.
findings.suggested_fix: Evaluate activeBatchStartSha dynamically when processing the queue: `const activeBatchStartSha = attempt === 1 ? itemLiveStartSha : itemBatchStartSha;` and use `activeBatchStartSha` for subsequent rollback and retry queueing.
